text: The token response can contain scopes different from those requested. OAuth2 splits and stores the returned scope list and compares exact entries; its Microsoft endpoint compatibility adjustment adds offline_access when the returned list omits it. Keep granted scope state separate from requested permissions. The historical accountSetup Google-discovery code is absent in current source and is not a current implementation recipe.
title: Treat granted OAuth scopes as token state, using exact scope tokens
